caseNameFull: John D. WARD v. UNITED STATES

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit denied. Justice Sotomayor, with whom Justice Ginsburg joins, dissenting from the denial of certiorari: I dissent for the reasons set out in *2627Brown v. United States, 586 U.S. ---- (2018) (Sotomayor, J., dissenting).
